newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
ALBANIA, Durres, May 27 - six vessels in port discharging of which 1 fish meal, 2 wheat flour, 1 wheat/maize, 2 cement. 2 vessels awaiting berth in roads for discharging sugar and cement.

BULGARIA, May 26 - Varna - east, 6 vessels loading at berth. 4 discharging at berth. 2 waiting at anchorage to load. 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge. West, 9 vessels loading at berth. 2 discharging at berth.

Bourgas - east, 14 vessels due. 10 vessels loading at berth. 3 discharging at berth. 18 waiting at anchorage to load. 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 3 vessels under repairs/drydock. West, 3 vessels loading at berth. 2 discharging at berth. 1 tanker loading at berth.

Bourgas - eighteen vessels operating of which 11 loading. 1 zinc, 4 fertiliser, 1 tobacco, 1 baryte concentrate, 3 steel, 1 chemicals. 5 discharging. 1 tobacco, 2 coal, 1 wheat, 1 sugar. 1 discharging/loading containers/general. 1 discharging/loading containers. 10 vessels waiting in roads of which 9 to load, 3 tankers, 1 timber, 1 copper cathodes, 2 steel, 1 cars, 1 alumina products. 1 to discharge/load containers. 12 vessels due of which 9 to load, 1 bentonite, 1 metals, 2 general, 4 steel, 1 other. 2 to discharge coal and other cargo. 1 to discharge/load containers.

Varna - forty-six vessels operating of which 23 loading, 4 cement, 2 quartz sand, 1 TSP, 1 frozen chickens/general, 2 clinker, 4 soda, 3 urea, 1 EDC, 1 fertiliser, 1 scrap, 1 kaoline, 1 glass, 1 general. 10 discharging, 2 wheat, 1 coal, 1 flour, 1 phosphate, 2 coal, 1 phosphorite, 1 granite, 1 cars. 1 discharging/loading phosphorite/NTP/soda. 10 discharging/loading containers. 2 discharging/loading trucks/containers. 14 vessels waiting in roads of which 3 to load, 1 cement, 1 clinker, 1 urea. 1 to discharge rice. 1 to discharge/load cars. 9 cargo not nominated.

ESTONIA, May 27 - Tallinn city port, 4 vessels due. No delays expected. 2 vessels loading at berth of which 1 pig iron, 1 steel sheets. 1 vessel discharging anode blocks at berth, 1 liner vessel. Kopli, 6 vessels due. No delays expected. 2 vessels loading at berth of which 1 sawn timber, 1 rice. Vessels discharging at berth 1 wheat flour, 1 meat. Parnu, 8 vessels due. No delays expected. 4 vessels loading at berth of which 3 timber, 1 boards. Muuga, 5 due. No delays expected. Loading at berth, 1 fuel oil, 1 boards, 1 scrap metal, 1 general cargo. Discharging at berth, 1 barley, 1 road metal, 2 benzene, 1 general cargo.

ITALY may 27 Naples, Gaeta, Salerno - no vessels in roads. Genoa commercial port - no vessels in roads. No delays. 22 vessels berthed. 4 vessels in drydock. Multedo oil harbour - no vessels in roads. No delays. 2 vessels berthed. Savona - no vessels in roads. No delays. 2 vessels berthed. Vado Ligure - no vessels in roads. No delays. 1 vessel berthed.

La Spezia - no vessels in roads. No delays. 8 vessels berthed. 4 vessels under repairs/drydock. Leghorn - seven vessels in roads. No days. 40 vessels berthed. Civitavecchia - one vessel in roads. Gaeta - one vessel in roads. No delays. Naples - one vessel in roads. No delays. Salerno - one vessel in roads. No delays.

Augusta oil harbour - one vessel in roads. 4 vessels berthed. Syracuse oil harbour - two vessels in roads. 2 vessels berthed. Palermo, Taranto, Ancona/Falconara - no vessels in roads. No delays. Sarroch, Ravenna, Venice - no delays. Trieste - one vessel in roads.

LATVIA, May 27 - Riga - eighteen vessels operating of which 5 timber loaders, 1 cotton loader, 2 container loader, 2 tanker loaders, 1 fertiliser loader, 3 frozen food dischargers, 2 awaiting operations, 2 sugar dischargers. No delays. 20 vessels due. Ventspils - seven vessels operating of which 2 steel loaders, 1 MOP loader, 1 miscellaneous, 2 awaiting instructions. No delays. 8 vessels due. Liepaja - twelve vessels operating. No delays. 5 vessels due.

LITHUANIA, Klaipeda - May 26 - vessels loading in port 2 timber, 3 fertiliser, 2 metal, 1 preparations, 1 scrap. Discharging 4 fish, 1 sugar. 1 vessel loading/discharging. 15 vessels due. POLAND, May 27, Szczecin - seventy-three vessels due. 30 loading at berth. 40 discharging at berth. 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 12 vessels under repairs/drydock.
PORTUGAL, May 26, Leixoes - vessels operating 9 general cargo, 3 container vessels. No vessels awaiting berth. Places vacant 4 piers with cranes, 2 piers without cranes.

Lisbon - thirty-three vessels due. 83 vessels in port. 6 loading at berth. Unloading at berth. 4 loading and unloading at berth. 2 loading at anchorage. 1 bunkering. 17 under repairs/drydock. 5 awaiting orders. 27 miscellaneous craft.

Sines - vessels operating 1 discharging crude, 1 each loading fuel oil, solid sulphur. 1 vessel waiting to discharge chemical naphtha. Vessels due 1 to discharge coal, 2 to load propylene, 1 each to load aromatics mixture, gasoil/gasoline/jet fuel, other cargo.
Setubal - May 27, seven vessels loading at berth. 6 discharging at berth. 5 vessels under repairs/drydock. Vessels due, 4 for discharging, 6 for loading, 1 for repairs/drydock.

ROMANIA, May 26, Constanta - thirty-three vessels operating of which 11 generals, 6 bulkers, 6 bagged chemicals, 4 tankers, 4 cement, 2 containers. 3 vessels waiting in roads for loading of which 1 general, 1 bulker, 1 tanker. Constantza sud (Agigea) - twelve vessels operating of which 10 generals, 1 bulker, 1 bagged chemicals. Mangalia - one vessel loading. Midia - five vessels loading livestock.

RUSSIA, May 26, Baltic ports, St. Petersburg - twenty-three vessels operating of which loading 4 non-ferrous, 5 fertiliser, 2 container vessels, 1 cellulose. Discharging 2 frozen chicken, 2 containers, 2 frozen meat, 2 bananas, 1 each cotton, alumina, sugar. 3 vessels awaiting operations. 2 vessels due.

Kaliningrad - seven vessels operating of which 6 loading (3 ferro alloys, 2 steel scrap, 1 coal). 1 vessel discharging/loading generals. 10 vessels due. Fishery port 3 vessels operating of which 2 discharging animal food, 1 loading oil. 2 vessels due. Vyborg - two vessels operating. No delays. 2 vessels due.

Far east ports, Vladivostok - fifteen vessels in port of which 2 passenger, 5 vessels loading (1 container, 2 timber, 2 metal), 1 general cargo discharging, 7 waiting. Nakhodka - nine vessels in port of which 6 loading (2 metal, 1 aluminium, 3 timber), 3 waiting. Vostochniy - ten vessels in port of which 6 loading (3 timber, 3 coal), 1 container discharging/loading, 3 vessels waiting. Posyet - one vessel loading ore. Zarubino - no vessels in port. No delays. No congestion.

Black Sea, Novorossiysk - twenty-one vessels operating of which 14 loading 1 cement, 7 steel, 2 scrap, 1 copper, 1 coal, 1 urea, 1 cellulose. 7 discharging 3 rice, 3 sugar, 1 various. 21 vessels waiting in roads of which 12 to load 1 copper, 2 fertiliser, 1 cement, 2 scrap, 4 steel, 1 cellulose, 1 paper. 9 to discharge, 3 sugar, 3 rice, 1 bananas, 1 citrus, 1 cars. 28 vessels due of which 21 to load 4 scrap, 12 steel, 1 lead, 2 zinc, 2 coal. 6 to discharge 4 sugar, 1 luggage, 1 other. 1 to discharge/load containers. Oil terminal 2 vessels berthed to load crude oil and diesel oil. 3 tankers (crude oil) waiting in roads. 9 tankers due in port to load 3 fuel oil and 6 crude oil.

Northern basin, Murmansk - May 27, four vessels operating of which 1 alumina, 1 steel, 1 apatite, 1 iron ore pellets. 1 apatite loader awaiting berth. 3 vessels due during the week of which 1 apatite loader, 2 dischargers (alumina, general cargo).

SPAIN, May 26 - Tarragona - port stevedore union has officially notified it will strike at the following times odd hours from 2/6 to 6/6 and 9/6 to 13/6. Aviles - four vessels in port of which 2 loading steel products, 2 discharging alumina and fertiliser. Gijon - three vessels loading (1 steel, 1 sugar, 1 coke). No delays or congestion.

Bilbao - 22 vessels operating (4 tankers, 18 dry cargo) of which 6 loading/discharging, 11 discharging, 5 loading. No delays. Cadiz - May 27, 21 vessels operating of which 3 ro/ro, 3 semolina, 3 shipbuilding material, 1 oil, 1 sand, 10 repairs. No delays.

Pasajes - 23 vessels in port of which 13 discharging scrap, 2 discharging grain, 1 each discharging steel, magnesite, coal, minerals, woodchip, 1 discharging/loading cars, 1 each loading steel, general cargo. No delays in port.

Sagunto - 23 vessels operating of which 10 discharging steel products, 1 loading steel products, 1 loading cement, 3 discharging/loading general cargo, 2 discharging/loading steel products, 3 loading bulk fertiliser, 1 loading chipboard, loading rice, 1 discharging anhydrous ammonia. No vessels berthed outside commercial wharf. No berthing delays.
